hyperedges.label: Executor revert taxonomy decoded by engine

nodes.label: setRouter(address,uint8) whitelist
nodes.rationale: Only way to allow a router; also types it and rejects code-less addresses so no router is allowed with a forgotten type.

nodes.label: Fee-on-transfer tokens unsupported
nodes.rationale: Real V2/Aerodrome pools revert (K) and V3 pools revert (IIA) when input arrives short.

nodes.label: Mock market (mUSDC/mWETH on real Uniswap V2/V3, ~3% apart)
nodes.norm_label: mock market (musdc/mweth on real uniswap v2/v3, ~3% apart)
nodes.rationale: Base Sepolia has little real liquidity; mock tokens on real DEX deployments let the engine use the same code path as mainnet with no test-only code.

nodes.label: QuoteCache (shared 2-hop Phase 1.5/1.5b)
nodes.rationale: Entry valid only while pool state matches and <=6s old; transport errors never suppress a pool.

nodes.label: Executor security properties (ReentrancyGuard, Ownable2Step, Pausable, whitelist)
nodes.norm_label: executor security properties (reentrancyguard, ownable2step, pausable, whitelist)

nodes.label: Phantom profits (V3 tick boundary)
nodes.rationale: xy=k spot formula treats V3 liquidity as continuous; crossing a tick boundary caps actual output, so local spread is fake.

nodes.label: Stable curve x3y+xy3=k Newton solver (dy<=1 wei convergence)
nodes.norm_label: stable curve x3y+xy3=k newton solver (dy<=1 wei convergence)
nodes.rationale: dy<=1 wei stop replaced dy==0 check that never triggered in normalized 1e18 space; 5-8 iterations vs fixed 255.

nodes.label: Six-Step Pipeline (Listen, Detect, Prepare, Submit, Confirm, Learn)
nodes.norm_label: six-step pipeline (listen, detect, prepare, submit, confirm, learn)

nodes.label: Event-sourced pool price state (push model)
nodes.rationale: Pull model (20-40 eth_call round trips, 200-600ms/scan) discarded; Swap/Sync events update a DashMap cache so scans are zero-I/O pure math.

nodes.label: Sell-leg V3 'Too little received' reverts
nodes.rationale: Most mined failures; detection overstates round-trip due to V3 spot math, stale V2 reserves, buy-leg amountOutMin=0.

nodes.label: Aerodrome Slipstream disabled
nodes.rationale: Factory reverts Uniswap's getPool(..., uint24 fee); real support needs a Slipstream router type in the contract.

nodes.label: Raise min_profit_usd floors (deferred)
nodes.rationale: Deferred: absolute $ floors hide most real edges at ~$1k/cycle; prefer haircut + telemetry.

nodes.label: Revert telemetry / revert_class classification
nodes.rationale: Phase 0: decode reverts (engine/src/revert.rs, chain/scan.rs), store in SQLite, establish 24-48h baseline before tuning.

nodes.label: Triangular V3-leg QuoterV2 verification (Phase 1.4)
nodes.rationale: V3 spot overestimate made triangular routes phantom; verifying with QuoterV2 brackets let min_triangular_profit_usd drop from $0.80 to $0.15.

nodes.label: minProfit enforced once on final balance (zero router min-out)
nodes.norm_label: minprofit enforced once on final balance (zero router min-out)
nodes.rationale: Price moves read as NotProfitable with exact shortfall on every DEX (PancakeSwap reverts with no reason otherwise); atomic tx protects capital like a router-level minimum.

nodes.label: Readable failures (custom errors decoded by revert.rs)
nodes.norm_label: readable failures (custom errors decoded by revert.rs)

nodes.label: ROUTER_MIN_OUT_SLACK_BPS
nodes.rationale: Execution-side slack in executor.rs (200 -> proposed 250 bps); lowers on-chain minOut so sell leg is easier to satisfy at inclusion; encoding-only, zero latency

nodes.label: P15_QUOTER_HAIRCUT_BPS (15 bps quoter haircut)
nodes.rationale: Centralized in strategy/mod.rs so Phase 1.5b and optimize.rs use the same haircut (previously hardcoded 8 bps); guards against overstated round-trip quotes.

nodes.label: pool_cache.prune_stale() heartbeat wiring
nodes.rationale: prune_stale exists but is never called; long-running engines accumulate dead pool entries and stale by_key indexes. Suggested TTL 30-60 min without Sync/Swap.

nodes.label: ROUTER_MIN_OUT_SLACK_BPS (200 -> 250)
nodes.rationale: Raise only if 'Too little received' reverts remain high after P0/P1 deploy.

nodes.label: Pool freshness guards (60s volatile / 120s stable)
nodes.rationale: Stale state is worse than no state - it produces phantom opportunities.

nodes.label: Circuit breaker (max_consecutive_failures)
nodes.rationale: Pauses chain after consecutive execution failures; RPC outages don't count; resume via POST /engine/resume.

nodes.label: RPC health / degraded mode (503)
nodes.rationale: When node hangs/down/too slow to simulate, detection continues but execution stops until monitor sees node healthy.

nodes.label: Dry-run first rollout
nodes.rationale: DRY_RUN=true for first run; go live only after a clean dry-run period.

nodes.label: Parallel submission RPCs (FCFS sequencer)
nodes.rationale: Signed txs broadcast to all submission RPCs at once because the Base sequencer is first-come-first-served.

nodes.label: Never cargo run -p engine from root with real .env
nodes.norm_label: never cargo run -p engine from root with real .env
nodes.rationale: Engine reads .env from working dir and ignores CLI flags; DRY_RUN=false with a funded key trades for real.

nodes.label: One chain per instance
nodes.rationale: Each engine serves exactly one chain; engine refuses to start if RPC chain id differs from chain.id.

nodes.label: tuning: config section
nodes.rationale: All timings/thresholds optional with Base defaults; block-relative timings scale with chain.block_time_ms; unknown keys rejected; requires restart.

nodes.label: Export tuning knobs to config.yaml
nodes.rationale: Move compile-time constants (haircut, slack, sell-leg minprofit mul, V3 spot max fraction) into hot-reloadable config.

nodes.label: Multi-RPC Broadcast Submission
nodes.rationale: Base orders txs FCFS; firing the signed tx to several RPCs races to reach the sequencer first.

nodes.label: Observability (exec_send/exec_confirm, SQLite, Prometheus)
nodes.rationale: Submitted != won; profit counted only when receipt status = 1; metrics tagged dry_run to separate shadow from live.

nodes.label: Base L2 as Target Chain
nodes.rationale: Traded mainnet liquidity for 2-second blocks and sub-cent fees; high volume and EVM compatibility allow scaling to other chains.

nodes.label: Off-chain Brain / On-chain Safety Net Split
nodes.norm_label: off-chain brain / on-chain safety net split
nodes.rationale: Engine optimizes and can be wrong; contract is the final judge enforcing profit and router whitelist in code.

nodes.label: Speed vs Accuracy Tuning Knobs (Quoter, size optimizer, preflight)
nodes.norm_label: speed vs accuracy tuning knobs (quoter, size optimizer, preflight)
nodes.rationale: Latency and correctness are a dial tuned per chain: QuoterV2 on (fewer bad sends), size optimizer off (+80-100ms), preflight off (latency).

nodes.label: preflight_eth_call
nodes.rationale: Rejected as primary fix: adds ~100-250ms, poor fit for FCFS/pending-monitor path
